video_title: Kevin Durant talks GTA 6, Lucia & says he's already on Chapter 3 😂

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant names Jaden McDaniels as an ideal GTA 6 player
quotes.excerpt: Jaden McDaniels would survive well in a GTA setting. Just go about his business, keep his head down.
quotes.quote: I would say Jaden McDaniels would survive well in a GTA setting. Just go about his business, keep his head down. Offensive and defensive, that's what you need out there in the streets. And he come from that, so he can adapt pretty quickly.
quotes.social_post: Kevin Durant says Jaden McDaniels would survive well in GTA 6 because he just goes about his business and keeps his head down. He thinks McDaniels can adapt pretty quickly to the streets.
